svg.title: Backend frameworks: first release, major versions and end of life
svg.desc: One row per framework: bar from the first release to today (dashed for legacy and historical entries), circles at the first stable release of each major version, a cross at the end of life. n/a means no release date could be sourced.
svg.text: Backend frameworks: first release, major versions and end of life
Year (first release from the package registry or the site page named in frameworks.csv)

text.tspan: Sources: crates-io, deps-dev, endoflife-date, go-proxy, hex, maven-central, npm-registry, nuget-registration, official-websites, packagist, pypi-json,
rubygems, site-aspnet-evolution, site-jsp-struts-history (see the Bibliography). Data as of 2026-10-27. Registry dates are first publication on the registry,
which can be later than the project launch.
